inventory_metadata.campaign_name: AV1 Library Group Inventory and Expanded Hallowed-Relative Baseline Campaign
inventory_metadata.scope: All locally available 2160p AV1 movie release groups across active library and calibration media
inventory_metadata.governance_notice: Evidence-only discovery and measurement artifact. Zero modifications to active operational tiers, profile scores, Custom Formats, release restrictions, or evidence/verdicts.csv.

groups.current_evidence_depth: Committed ledger evidence: 3 titles / 11 scenes (mean VMAF 95.77, floor 91.10). Op 944A adds descriptive Hallowed→AV1-only observation on Dark Phoenix (4 scenes).
groups.rationale: High-fidelity AV1 group holding candidate status. X-Men: Dark Phoenix (2019) provides a clean same-master chain against Hallowed 2160p x265 (46.46 dB PSNR-Y baseline).
